tasks.short: Evaluate and revise arts curricula and teaching methods

steps.what: Evaluate curricula using student work and course experience
Revise course content, materials and proposed methods of instruction

loop.purpose: Draft targeted revisions from teacher-selected priorities
loop.input: Existing curriculum, approved materials and revision priorities
loop.output: Tracked revisions with rationale and source links
loop.check: Teacher checks that changes address the diagnosed learning issue, preserve artistic breadth and fit studio or rehearsal constraints
loop.stop: One revision then manual editing if educational meaning or feasibility remains wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cannot interpret qualitative curriculum feedback or write varied teaching approaches

steps.what: Approve the revised curriculum and verify practical teaching feasibility

tasks.design: Use tracked revisions in {DOCS} and a bounded drafting loop for changes specified by the teacher. Keep evaluation of student work, artistic choices and practical approval with the teacher before updating materials in {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning qualitative course reflections into consistent revised documents takes repeated writing.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can express explicit revision priorities while preserving source links.
tasks.still_hard: A coherent syllabus can still narrow artistic exploration or overload rehearsal time.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the educational and artistic value of the course as a whole.
tasks.altitude: Less revision drafting; curriculum decisions stay with the teacher.

reach.learn: Prerequisites, studio capacity and artistic breadth

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting of teacher-specified arts curriculum revisions is an E1 design without measured digest evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is curriculum evaluation and revision, excluding individual teaching-aid production and classroom delivery.

The teacher produces diagnosed learning issue, intended outcome, revision scope, resource versions and studio or rehearsal limits in s1, retaining all 30 hours. Missing constraints require clarification rather than model invention.
Test native tracked changes and reusable course templates first. Retained s2 time includes correction; all final practical review remains in s3.
unknowns: Reusable course templates and resource permissions
research_questions: Do draft revisions address the teacher's diagnosed issue while preserving artistic and practical requirements?

already_counted.description: Curriculum evaluation, draft correction and final review

incremental.description: Maintain source versions and review recurring revision errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact curriculum revision including outcomes, repertoire or materials, teaching methods and timetable assumptions; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+27+25=82; gross 18%, minus four upkeep gives 14% central net. Low assumes only six drafting hours removable because artistic revisions need extensive correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade arts examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations and define performance or portfolio assessment criteria

loop.purpose: Draft examination instructions from teacher-selected outcomes and assessment type
loop.input: Course outcomes, teacher brief and approved assessment rules
loop.output: Draft examination instructions and criteria for teacher approval
loop.check: Teacher verifies that each task elicits the intended artistic skill, is feasible in the allotted time and has clear fair criteria
loop.stop: One revision then manual compilation if validity or feasibility is uncertain
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot draft distinct portfolio and performance tasks from varied artistic outcomes

steps.what: Administer the examination and address student questions and practical issues
Grade performances or submitted work against the approved criteria

tasks.design: Use a bounded {DOCS} draft for examination instructions and criteria, after the teacher specifies the artistic outcomes and assessment format. Keep administration and all performance, portfolio and grade judgements with the examiner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing clear examination briefs repeats structural work while tasks vary by artistic discipline.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-limited draft can reduce wording work without evaluating student performance.
tasks.still_hard: An assessment must elicit the intended skill fairly and under workable conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate artistic interpretation, technique and development in the actual work.
tasks.altitude: Less examination-brief drafting; assessment authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Check assessment validity and delivery arrangements

evidence.claim: The digest's Ans capability concerns closed-question marking and distribution of open questions; it does not establish artistic-performance grading.
Only examination-brief drafting is reduced here; the teacher-reviewed draft and savings are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes examination compilation, administration and grading by this teacher. No grading work is transferred to an assistant and no automated artistic assessment is assumed.
The teacher supplies outcomes, assessment type, permitted materials, timing and criteria in retained s1 time; 21 hours remain for brief capture, draft corrections and final validity approval.
Test native assessment templates first; the bounded loop drafts instructions only. Absent or conflicting criteria stop drafting for manual compilation. Student evidence never enters the loop.
unknowns: Assessment format and local examiner authority
research_questions: Can reviewed examination drafts save wording time without weakening assessment validity?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, instruction correction and final examination approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved examination guidance and templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact examination tasks, instructions, timing and criteria after teacher review; edits require renewed approval
Exact student evidence, criteria version, scores and final result; changed evidence or scores void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=21+25+45=91; gross 9%, minus three upkeep gives 6% central net. Low assumes four compilation hours removed; administration and artistic grading remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hold office hours to advise students

steps.what: Maintain office hours to advise and assist students

tasks.design: Keep office-hour availability and student advice with the teacher. Existing times in {CALENDAR} remain sufficient; no separate booking-administration baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the student's question, work and circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduled hours already provide access.
tasks.still_hard: A student may need a sensitive conversation rather than a quick factual answer.
tasks.human_edge: Offer context-sensitive feedback and recognise when further support is needed.
tasks.altitude: Office-hour availability and advisory responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Support students facing barriers to participation

evidence.claim: Student advice and scheduled availability retain their time in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is holding office hours and advising students, excluding separate administrative scheduling.
No new structured student profile or automated advice is introduced.
Existing native calendar access is sufficient and no new process requires maintenance, justifying zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Student advice needs and existing access arrangements
research_questions: Can students obtain appropriate advice during the available hours?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Advice and scheduled availability are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks and performance materials

steps.what: Select textbooks, performance pieces and supplies for their educational suitability
Obtain selected materials through approved orders or access requests

tasks.design: Keep artistic and educational selection with the teacher, then reuse approved catalogue entries and request templates in {PROCUREMENT}. The teacher checks edition, quantity, delivery and rights before confirming the request; purchasing retains its existing order authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen materials are repeatedly re-entered into purchasing requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogues and saved requests reduce copying without choosing the materials.
tasks.still_hard: An edition or performance piece may require specific rights or suit only some learners.
tasks.human_edge: Select artistically worthwhile materials appropriate to the course and students.
tasks.altitude: Less purchasing-request entry; material choices and approval responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.task: Source the correct editions and performance rights

evidence.claim: Native catalogue reuse can reduce request entry while leaving artistic selection and rights checks intact; this is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's selection and acquisition request, excluding supplier fulfilment, purchasing approval and physical distribution.

The teacher identifies title or material ID, edition, quantity, intended use, delivery need and rights scope during s1 and retained s2 time. All 70 selection hours and 15 request hours remain; incomplete identifiers or rights require manual clarification there.
The purchasing team maintains existing approved supplier catalogue IDs, prices and terms; additional mapping work is counted below. Test native saved requests before custom integration.
unknowns: Catalogue coverage and existing request-entry time
research_questions: Can saved requests remove copying while preserving edition and rights checks?

incremental.description: Maintain saved request details and resolve catalogue exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact title or material, edition, quantity, intended use, rights scope and delivery request; changes require reconfirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70+15=85; gross 15%, minus three focal upkeep gives 12% central net. Low assumes five copying hours removed when many items are outside catalogues; selection and rights checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less curriculum wording, examination compilation and purchasing entry, with artistic selection, grading and student advice retained.
reach: Work with programme coordinators on coherent artistic progression
role.ambitious_version: An arts teacher with more attention available for student work and artistic development.

job.title: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
